impact.text: incorrect and inconsistent reward accrual due to unsynced totalSupply().

precondition_sources.text: SiloVault accrues fees from interest, measured as delta totalAssets, by minting additional shares to the fee receiver.
When claiming rewards directly through claimRewards(), the accrued extra share is updated first before _claimRewards().

intent_sources.text: Reward accrual must be correct and consistent, not based on an unsynced totalSupply().
